{{Top|leg}}
'''Chrenda''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merakai]]. It was the site of a mass demonstration by [[Khil]] residents against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] barring them from government jobs. In retaliation, the Empire razed all civilian [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] facilities and sent [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] through the [[City/Legends|city]] shooting the protesters.
